Adolescent faustery is the process where a growing human ignores spirituality and thus falls into [[Faustery]] not through transhumanistic means but rather through their own growing intelligence.

It is a common affliction that is ubiquitous among intelligent teenagers today

It is related to the more benign phenomenon of [[adolescent tripping]] which occurs without active disregard for spirituality
